To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
two genes encoding Ser/Thr-His protein kinases (Pkn41 and Pkn42) are regulated by iron and nitrogen status via the global regulator NtcA.
two genes encoding proteins with Ser/Thr kinase and His kinase domains are regulated by NtcA and are involved in the regulation of iron acquisition and nitrogen fixation.

pkn41 andpkn42, two members of a family of 12 genes encoding proteins containing both a Ser/ Thr kinase domain and aHis kinase domain, are induced by iron deprivation and that their induction requires the transcription factor NtcA.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of a pair of genes encoding protein kinases with Ser/Thr and His kinase domains that respond to iron limitation.
the role of pkn41/pkn42 as a new regulatory factor of iron acquisition in Anabaena sp.
the characterization of two new iron-responsive genes encoding protein kinases that may play a role in iron homeostasis and nitrogen fixation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the expression of the pkn41 and/or pkn42 genes is induced by iron limitation and that the pkn41/pkn42 genes are involved in iron acquisition and/or iron homeostasis.
pkn41 and 42 are iron-responsive genes that are regulated by NtcA and are involved in iron homeostasis in the cyanobacterium.
NtcA regulates the expression of pkin41 and pkin42, which encode two iron-responsive kinases that regulate iron acquisition and nitrogen fixation in the cyanobacterium.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
pkn41 and 42 are regulated by NtcA and are required for the optimal growth of Anabaena sp.
NtcA, the master transcriptional regulator for nitrogen metabolism in cyanobacteria, also regulates iron homeostasis.
NtcA is a global regulator for iron-responsive genes in Anabaena sp.
The main takeaway from our work is that
pkn41 and its partner pkn42 are iron-responsive genes whose expression is regulated by the transcription factor NtcA.
the expression of pkin41 and pkn41 is regulated by NtcA and is induced in response to iron deprivation.
the expression of two members of a family of 14 genes encoding protein kinases with a Ser-Thr kinase domain and a histidine kinase domain, pkn41 and 42, is controlled by NtcA.
